```powershell
# Rokit: download rokit-*-windows-x86_64.exe from https://github.com/rojo-rbx/rokit/releases, then:

# open a new terminal so ~/.rokit/bin is on PATH
cd <runs>\set-up-rokit-sonnet-old-1
rokit install      # approve the trust prompts for each tool
rojo --version; wally --version; stylua --version; selene --version; luau-lsp --version
```
